settings.title: Paris Shopping, Done For You.
settings.subtitle: Luxury brands at Paris outlet prices — hand-picked for you and shipped across Europe and worldwide.

settings.title: No visa, no trip
settings.text: Shopping in Paris without a travel visa, without taking a week off work.

settings.title: Zero travel costs
settings.text: No flights, no week of hotel, no restaurants — your budget goes into the products, not the trip.

settings.title: 2 – 2.5× cheaper
settings.text: Luxury items are often 2 to 2.5 times cheaper than at home, where import taxes and duties inflate prices.

settings.title: Delivered to your door
settings.text: Outlet prices (-30% to -70%), tracked parcels shipped across Europe and worldwide.

settings.title: Paris luxury, without the Paris trip
Create your account
settings.text: Sign up with your delivery address and contact details — everything stays saved for your orders.

settings.title: Send your shopping list
settings.text: Build your list on the My List page: paste the links of the items you want, with sizes and prices.

settings.title: Pay the deposit
settings.text: A deposit matching the estimated total of your shopping + my provisional fee, validated together.

settings.title: Book a call
settings.text: Tell me your date and time availability for a phone exchange about your list.

settings.title: I scout, you validate, I buy
settings.text: After our call I go to the boutiques, report back on the items found matching your request — and buy them upon your validation.

settings.title: Tracked delivery
settings.text: Carefully packed and shipped with tracking to the address from your account — Europe & worldwide.

settings.title: Simple, transparent fees
settings.rate_note: Minimum commission 300 €. No minimum purchase. Includes outlet trips, in-store scouting, photos & phone debrief, secure packing and shipment handling.

settings.question: How does payment work?
settings.answer: After we validate your list together, you pay a deposit covering the estimated purchases + my provisional fee (Wise, PayPal or bank transfer).

settings.question: How do I know it's authentic?
settings.answer: All products are bought in the official boutiques of the Paris outlets. Original invoice, receipt and photos are sent with every purchase.

settings.question: Where do you deliver?
settings.answer: Across Europe and worldwide, with a tracked parcel to the address on your account.

settings.question: Are there customs duties?
settings.answer: Depending on your country, import duties may apply on arrival — they remain the client's responsibility. I manage the process transparently and inform you upfront.

settings.question: Are returns possible?
settings.answer: The boutiques' return policies apply. For a wrong size or colour we do our utmost to find the best solution with you.
